landing.heroTitle: Turn your sales sheets into clear reports in minutes
landing.heroSubtitle: Upload a CSV or Excel file and get dashboards, an AI-written summary, beautiful PDF reports and invoices — in 15 languages and 60 currencies.
landing.demoNote: No sign-up needed. Demo login is filled in for you.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to understand your sales
landing.featuresSubtitle: One tool for analysis, reporting and billing — built for small businesses and agencies.

features.title: CSV & Excel upload
features.body: Drag and drop a file; columns are detected and mapped automatically.

features.title: AI sales summary
features.body: Plain-language insights from OpenAI, Gemini or Claude, with a free rule-based fallback.

features.title: Interactive charts
features.body: Daily and monthly trends, top products, best weekdays and top customers.

features.title: PDF reports
features.body: Branded, print-ready sales reports with your logo and colours.

features.title: Invoices
features.body: Create, track and download professional PDF invoices in any currency.

features.title: Multi-language & multi-currency
features.body: 15 languages including English, Bangla, Arabic, Urdu, Chinese and Japanese — and 60 currencies with one-click conversion.

features.title: Customers & products
features.body: A simple admin panel to manage your catalogue and client list.

features.title: Secure by default
features.body: Roles, CSRF protection, rate limiting, encrypted API keys and account lockout.
